q1.question: What is the First Challenge?
q1.answer: It's a {{duration}}-day event for new players to complete simple tasks and earn special rewards. Think of it as your warm-up round — complete tasks, climb progress, and unlock your first bonuses!

q2.question: How long does the First Challenge last?
q2.answer: You have {{duration}} days from the time you register your account. Once the countdown ends, any unclaimed rewards will expire, so don't miss your chance!

q3.question: How do I earn rewards?
q3.answer: Each completed task adds to your total progress bar. When your total bonus reaches {{target_amount}}, you can claim it and add it to your account balance.

q4.question: Can I claim rewards before completing everything?
q4.answer: Yes! You can collect any unlocked rewards as soon as they become available — as long as your total bonus has reached {{target_amount}}. You don't need to finish every task first.

q5.question: Can I join the First Challenge again later?
q5.answer: The First Challenge is a one-time event for new players only. It's designed as an introduction to our Conquests and Achievements, which are available to all players for long-term progression.

q6.question: How do I check my progress?
q6.answer: You can view your current progress bar and task list on the event page. Tasks that are done will show a green checkmark, and new ones unlock automatically.

q7.question: How are my rewards calculated and credited?
q7.answer: All rewards are calculated and credited in BUCK/USDT, then displayed in your preferred fiat currency for convenience. Please note that currency conversions are approximate and may vary slightly depending on the exchange rate at the time.

q8.question: Are there any rules or restrictions I should know about?
q8.answer: Yes. The casino reserves the right to modify, suspend, or revoke eligibility for this event at any time without prior notice. Any abuse, multiple account usage, or fraudulent activity will result in immediate disqualification from the promotion.
